episodes.title: Fionna Campbell
episodes.summary: After a disastrous morning, Fionna can't afford to take Cake to the vet, so she seeks help from an unconventional source.

episodes.title: Simon Petrikov
episodes.summary: Simon struggles to be a regular human in a magical world and considers taking desperate measures.

episodes.title: Cake the Cat
episodes.summary: After crash-landing in a fantastic new world, Cake takes on Ooo, while a desperate Fionna continues her search. Later, Simon opens the portal one last time.

episodes.title: Prismo the Wishmaster
episodes.summary: While learning more about their connection from Prismo, Fionna, Cake and Simon become the target of a dangerous new enemy.

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.summary: Pursued by a powerful enemy, Fionna, Cake, and Simon venture through a lawless world in search of a magical artifact.

episodes.title: The Winter King
episodes.summary: Fionna and Simon discover their best selves, and a possible solution to all their problems, in a wintery kingdom. Marshall Lee helps Gary with a baking project.

episodes.title: The Star
episodes.summary: Cake is recruited by a band of skilled vampire hunters. Gary and Marshall Lee attend a black-tie party.

episodes.title: Jerry
episodes.summary: Stranded in a desolate land, Fionna, Cake, and Simon are stranded and resort to desperate measures to escape.

episodes.title: Casper & Nova
episodes.summary: Simon finds his mind transported across time and space while danger closes in on Fionna and Cake.

episodes.title: Cheers
episodes.summary: Fionna, Cake, and friends fight for their world. Simon battles his demons.

episodes.title: The Hare and the Sprout
episodes.summary: After saving their world from Scarab, Fionna and Cake attempt to find a place for themselves in it while helping their friends make a home out of an abandoned lot. Back in Ooo, Huntress Wizard makes a shocking discovery -- and turns to Simon for help.

episodes.title: The Crocodile Who Bit a Log
episodes.summary: While Fionna, Cake, and their friends strategize different ways to take back their lot from Queenie, Huntress Wizard travels to the Heart of the Forest and contends with a secret order of Wizards.

episodes.title: The Lion of Embers
episodes.summary: Given just a week to save the lot, Fionna puts together a fundraiser and revisits an old flame. As a nervous Cake goes on a first date, Huntress Wizard struggles in a magic-free world. Back in Ooo, PB and Marceline face down a hoard of eager Princesses.

episodes.title: The Cat Who Tipped The Box
episodes.summary: A heartbroken Fionna takes a walk down memory lane, while Cake explores a career in television. Later, Huntress Wizard searches for a way home.

episodes.title: The Butterfly and the River
episodes.summary: After several setbacks, Fionna's quest to save the lot takes a costly turn, while Huntress and Cake begrudgingly join forces to explore an enigmatic vision of the future.

episodes.title: The Bird in the Clock
episodes.summary: While Fionna's latest bid to save the lot throws Marshall for a loop, Huntress Wizard chases the Cosmic Owl. Later, Fionna and Huntress attempt to save Finn from an impending Croak Dream.

episodes.title: The Wolves Who Wandered
episodes.summary: When DJ Flame goes missing, Fionna turns to magic -- and an unlikely ally -- for help with the search. As Huntress attempts to navigate the Heart of the Forest alone, Marshall learns a critical truth about his mother.

episodes.title: The Insect that Sang
episodes.summary: After Fionna and Huntress are captured, Cake tries to pull off Boys Night and save the lot on her own. Meanwhile, PB, Simon, and Marcie venture into the forest.

episodes.title: The Worm and his Orchard
episodes.summary: After plunging into the unknown, Huntress faces off with an old foe, Fionna contends with painful memories, and Cake confronts her inner truth with help from the Karmic Worm.

episodes.title: The Bear and the Rose
episodes.summary: As time runs out for a wounded hero, PB turns to science for solutions, while Huntress fights to make her way back to Ooo to stop her. Later, Fionna seeks to undo a disastrous decision.
